compos.summarization: This smartphone UI screen is designed for selecting a gender. It features two circular icons representing male and female options. Above these icons, there is a text prompt that says "Select Gender." Below the icons, there is a "NEXT" button to proceed after making a selection. The screen also contains advertisements at the top and bottom. The top ad promotes the game "Candy Crush Soda Saga," while the bottom ad offers a service for creating resumes.
